list_source.how_68_identified: Main text 'Contaminated evidence in clinical practice guidelines': 218 substantially impacted meta-analyses (both direction and P-value significance changed; n=218 in Results) from 68 systematic reviews, cited as references 23-90 (19 Cochrane, 49 non-Cochrane).

list_source.contact_not_used: Paper says whole datasets from first author on request; not contacted per protocol.

sampling.positives: Up to 40 non-retracted reviews from paper refs 23-90. First 15 are the 16 Oct 2026 sealed sample (high-signal then Cochrane/non-Cochrane mix). Remaining slots fill in paper-ref order. Carlisle 2006 Cochrane PONV (ref 45, 10.1002/14651858.cd004125.pub2) excluded because Crossref/OpenAlex mark the review itself retracted. Ref 82 had no DOI.
sampling.controls: 10 journal-year matched reviews frozen on 16 Oct 2026 for 10 of the 15 sampled positives. Five sampled positives (refs 87, 41, 84, 56, 64) and the 25 extra frozen positives are unpaired. n_pos=40, n_ctrl=10 is a partial equal-n set; do not invent extra controls after seeing MoolTrace verdicts.

control_check: Same OpenAlex primary_location.source.id and publication_year as a sampled distorted review; OpenAlex type=review (two documented replacements); DOI not in VITALITY OSF All-sheet (805 unique review DOIs from 'All in one final - 30_Dec updated 3.xlsx' on osf.io/7eazq); OpenAlex is_retracted=false on the review; none of the first 80 OpenAlex referenced_works had is_retracted=true. Two replacements: PRISMA 2020 reporting guideline swapped for JCE 2021 exercise-for-LBP SR (10.1016/j.jclinepi.2021.05.020); CD007768.pub3 (634 refs) swapped for CD011231 (20 refs). OpenAlex is_retracted can miss notices; the OSF All-sheet exclusion is the primary check that the control did not include one of the 1330 VITALITY retracted RCTs. First author was not emailed. Control matching was frozen on 16 Oct 2026 (prior partial run) and was not relabelled after seeing MoolTrace verdicts.
